prompt: Create a UI design mockup for the drag-and-drop state of TripLOG, a Korean travel itinerary planner. Show one cohesive design in a 912px-wide desktop timeline crop and a 390px-wide mobile timeline crop, both at readable native UI scale. The existing product uses a white background, dark ink, yellow accents, a left time rail, and compact itinerary cards. Show a hotel card being moved between two itinerary stops. Preserve the picked card's original dimensions and text arrangement so it stays anchored to the user's grab point. Make the destination position immediately clear with a restrained, elegant insertion indicator and carefully balanced spacing. Prioritize the place name, then time and category, then the memo. Use these example contents: “11:00”, “순천만국가정원”, “명소”, “입장권과 편한 신발 챙기기”; “18:00”, “순천 호텔”, “숙소”, “체크인 후 저녁 산책”. Design a refined replacement for the oversized pale-blue dashed drop area. Keep the surrounding timeline structure recognizable and all text and controls practical to implement in HTML and CSS.
scope: Drag feedback component only: gold insertion line and dot, pale yellow drop label, original card with a soft lift shadow. Existing timeline content and layout remain the basis for implementation.
